def solve(I):
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in I for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cands=[c for c,vv in cnt.items() if c!=bg and vv==4]
    res=None
    for m in cands:
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(len(I)) for c in range(len(I[0])) if I[r][c]==m]
        rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        R,C=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
        out=[[bg]*C for _ in range(R)]
        ok=True
        for mr,mc in pts:
            rr,cc=mr-r0,mc-c0
            if (rr,cc) not in {(0,0),(0,C-1),(R-1,0),(R-1,C-1)}: ok=False; break
        if ok: res=out; break
    return res
for n in [1,2,3,4,5]:
    print(n,'match' if solve(G['Demo pair %d input'%n])==G['Demo pair %d output'%n] else 'MISMATCH')

# Find marker cells: color != bg, occurring at extreme rows/cols. Markers: 4 same-colored single pixels in corners of a rectangle.
def find_markers(I):
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in I for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0])
    cands={}
    for m,vv in cnt.items():
        if m==bg or vv!=4: continue
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if I[r][c]==m]
        if len(pts)==4: cands[m]=pts
    return cands,bg
for n in [1,2,3,4,5]:
    I=G['Demo pair %d input'%n]; O=G['Demo pair %d output'%n]
    cands,bg=find_markers(I)

for n in [1,2,3,4,5]:
    I=G['Demo pair %d input'%n]; O=G['Demo pair %d output'%n]
    cnt={}
    for r in I:
        for v in r: cnt[v]=cnt.get(v,0)+1
    bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    # marker color: exactly 4 cells
    marks=[m for m,v in cnt.items() if v==4]
    print('demo',n,'bg',bg,'marks',marks)
    mr=next(iter(marks))
    pts={(r,c) for r in range(len(I)) for c in range(len(I[0])) if I[r][c]==mr}
    rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    print('  marker box rows',r0,'-',r1,'cols',c0,'-',c1, 'size',(r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1),'out',len(O),'x',len(O[0]))

from collections import Counter
def analyze(g, verbose=True):
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    best=None
    for col,n in cnt.items():
        if n<4: continue
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==col]
        rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs_=[p[1] for p in pts]
        minr,maxr=min(rs),max(rs); minc,maxc=min(cs_),max(cs_)
        corners={(minr,minc),(minr,maxc),(maxr,minc),(maxr,maxc)}
        if corners<=set(pts):
            # prefer most cells
            if best is None or n>best['n']: best={'n':n,'col':col,'rect':(minr,maxr,minc,maxc),'pts':pts}
    return best

def fit_translation(i):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {i} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    cnt=Counter(x for row in gi for x in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    Cs=comps_of(gi,bg)
    h,w=len(go),len(go[0])
    # try translations for each comp whose bbox fits; score overlap
    best={}
    for o in sorted(Cs,key=lambda o:(o['color'],min(p[0] for p in o['cells']))):
        rs=[p[0] for p in o['cells']]; cs=[p[1] for p in o['cells']]
        r0_,r1_,c0_,c1_=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        dr_min,r_max=r0_-h+1,h-1; dc_min,c_max=c0_-w+1,w-1
        cands=[]
        for dr in range(dr_min,r_max+1):
            for dc in range(dc_min,c_max+1):
                rr=(r0_+dr-(r1_+1)) if False else r0_+dr
                occ=set((rr+dy,cc+dc) for dy in range(r0_,r1_+1) for cc_ in range(c0_,c1_+1) if (rr+dy,cc_) in o['cells'])
                ov=sum(1 for p in occ if 0<=p[0]<h and 0<=p[1]<w and go[p[0]][p[1]]==o['color'])
                cands.append((ov,len(occ)))
        cands.sort(reverse=True)
        best[o['color']]=cands[:3]
    return best
for i in [3,7]:
    print('demo',i)
    for k,v in fit_translation(i).items(): print(' ',k,v)

def objects(i):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {i} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    cnt=Counter(x for row in gi for x in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    Cs=comps_of(gi,bg)
    objs=[]
    for o in sorted(Cs,key=lambda o:(o['color'],min(p[0] for p in o['cells']))):
        rs=[p[0] for p in o['cells']]; cc=[p[1] for p in o['cells']]
        objs.append((o['color'],tuple(sorted(o['cells']))))
    return gi,go,bg,objs

def solve_demo(i,verbose=False):
    gi,go,bg,objs=objects(i)
    # identify marker color: color whose cells are all isolated singletons AND count>=4, appearing at 4 corners? Just use: marker = color with cells count==number of comps==4 all singleton
    from collections import Counter as Ct
    ccount=Ct(len([cells for cells,_ in objs]) )
    # marker color = most common singleton color with exactly 4 comps
    single=[o for o in objs if len(o[1])==1]
    mk=Ct(o[0] for o in single)
    mkcol=mk.most_common(1)[0][0]
    bars=[o for o in objs if o[0]!=mkcol]
    H,W=len(go),len(go[0])
    # target size: bars identical rect; infer from demo output rects
    def rects(g):
        Cs=comps_of(g,bg)
        out=[]
        for o in Cs:
            rs=[p[0] for p in o['cells']]; cc=[p[1] for p in o['cells']]
            r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cc),max(cc)
            full=all(g[r][c]==o['color'] for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1))
            out.append((o['color'],r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1,(r0,c0)))
        return out
    outs=rects(go)
    tgt=(outs[0][1],outs[0][2])
    return gi,go,tgt,bars,mkcol,dict(outs)
for i in [3,4,5,6,7,8]:
    gi,go,tgt,bars,mk,d = solve_demo(i)
    print(i,'tgt',tgt,'n bars',len(bars),'colors',[b[0] for b in bars],'markers',{mk})

    def rc(g,bg):
        out=[]
        for o in comps_of(g,bg):
            rs=[p[0] for p in o['cells']]; cs=[p[1] for p in o['cells']]
            r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cc if False else cs)
            if False: pass
            full=all(g[r][c]==o['color'] for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1))
            if full: out.append((o['color'],r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1,(r0,c0),(r1-r0,cc)))
        return out
    print(' in ',rc(gi,bg))
    bgo=Counter(x for row in go for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

# Fresh analysis of all 8 pairs with full structure dump
def dump(i):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {i} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    cnt=Counter(x for row in gi for x in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    Cs=comps_of(gi,bg)
    sgl=[o for o in Cs if len(o['cells'])==1]
    mk=Counter(o['color'] for o in sgl).most_common(1)[0][0]
    marks=[list(o['cells'])[0] for o in sgl if o['color']==mk]
    fr0=min(p[0] for p in marks); fr1=max(p[0] for p in marks); tc0=min(p[1] for p in marks); tc1=max(p[1] for p in marks)
    F=(fr1-fr0+1,tc1-tc0+1)
    print(f'--- demo {i}: bg={bg} marker={mk} frame={F}')
    for o in sorted(Cs,key=len):
        rs=[p[0] for p in o['cells']]; cc=[p[1] for p in o['cells']]
        h,w=max(rs)-min(rs)+1,max(cc)-min(cc)+1
        r0,c0=min(rs),min(cc)
        tag='MARKER' if o['color']==mk else ''
        print(f'  comp c{o["color"]} n{len(o["cells"])} bbox({r0},{c0}) {h}x{w} {"REL:" if not tag else ""}' + tag)
for i in [3,4,5,6,7,8]:
    dump(i)

def analyze(i):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {i} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    cnt=Counter(x for row in gi for x in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]

    marks=[list(o['cells'])[0] for o in sgl if o['color']==mk]

def analyze(i):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {i} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    cnt=Counter(x for row in gi for x in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    Cs=comps_of(gi,bg)
    sgl=[o for o in Cs if len(o['cells'])==1]
    mk=Counter(o['color'] for o in sgl).most_common(1)[0][0]
    marks=[list(o['cells'])[0] for o in sgl if o['color']==mk]
    fr0=min(p[0] for p in marks); fr1=max(p[0] for p in marks); tc0=min(p[1] for p in marks); tc1=max(p[1] for p in marks)
    objs=[o for o in Cs if o['color']!=mk and len(o['cells'])>1]
    th=max(max(rs)-min(rs)+1 for rs in [[p[0] for p in o['cells']] for o in objs])
    tw=max(max(cc)-min(cc)+1 for cc in [[p[1] for p in o['cells']] for o in objs])
    # tile positions from output comps
    occ=set()
    outpos={}
    for c in comps_of(go,bg):
        if c['color']==bg: continue
        if len(c['cells'])>1: 
            rs=[p[0] for p in c['cells']]; cc=[p[1] for p in c['cells']]
            outpos[c['color']]=(min(rs),min(cc))
            occ|=set(c['cells'])
    return dict(F=(fr1-fr0+1,tc1-tc0+1),objs=objs,mk=mk,objdim=(th,tw),
                outpos=outpos,outH=len(go),outW=len(go[0]),occ=occ)
D={i:analyze(i) for i in range(1,9)}

def cmp(i):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {i} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    cnt=Counter(x for row in gi for x in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=components(gi,bg)
    sgl=[c[0] for c in cs if len(c)==1]; bars=[c for c in cs if len(c)>1]
    cols={p:gi[p[0]][p[1]] for p in sgl}
    mk=Counter(cols.values()).most_common(1)[0][0]
    marks=[p for p in sgl if cols[p]==mk]
    rs=[p[0] for p in marks]; cc=[p[1] for p in marks]
    fr=min(rs); fc=min(cc); fh=max(rs)-fr+1; fw=max(cc)-fc+1
    # bars -> relative pos & shape
    binfo=[]
    for b in bars:
        r0=min(p[0] for p in b); c0=min(p[1] for p in b)
        h=max(p[0] for p in b)-r0+1; w=max(p[1] for p in b)-c0+1
        binfo.append(dict(col=cols[(r0,c0)] if (r0,c0) in cols else gi[r0][c0],
                          rel=(r0-fr,c0-fc),h=h,w=w))
    # output: group colored cells by component, ignore markers
    ocomp={}
    for c in components(go,bg):
        col=go[c[0][0]][c[0][1]]
        if col==mk: continue
        rs=[p[0] for p in c]; cc=[p[1] for p in c]
        ocomp[col]=(min(rs),min(cc),len(rs),len(cc))
    return dict(F=(fh,fw),binfo=binfo,ocomp=ocomp,mk=mk,origi=gi)
for i in range(1,9):
    v=cmp(i)
    print('---',i,v['F'])
    for b in v['binfo']: print('   bar',b['col'],'rel',b['rel'],'shape',(b['h'],b['w']))
    print('   out comps:',{k:v_ for k,v_ in sorted(v['ocomp'].items())})
